text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide crosses the finish line in first!
The final jewel of the Classic Triple Crown, the Kikuka Sho, is claimed by Biwa Hayahide!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I won...
The Kikuka Sho, where the strongest horse girl reigns supreme—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I'm the one! Who won!!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: ...Um, Hayahide-san—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations!
That was a great run!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Ah, thank you!
Heh... I'm getting uncharacteristically excited.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I think it's okay to be even happier!
I'd love to see that side of you too, Hayahide-san!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Haha, you sure know how to butter me up!

A tremendous wave of cheers and applause naturally erupted.
The grandstands were filled with a refreshing, uplifting atmosphere.

And then, the Winning Live.
Royce and Royce stood beside Biwa Hayahide,
beaming with a bright smile.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, Hayahide-san!
Everyone! Let's hype this up with all we've got!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Ticket-saaan!
Here you go!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Yaaaay!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Hayahide-san...!
Today was really—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: In praise of your valiant effort.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Taishin-san, I'm counting on you!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, they're super close!
That's sooooo emotional~!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Man... talk about youth!!

On the way back, Royce and Royce seemed utterly ungrounded,
as if her excitement still hadn't faded in the slightest.
choice_data_list: The youthful route was a huge success!
The youthful route was a huge success, wasn't it!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: —Ah! Self-producing!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
That's right!
Riding on the friendship of BNW, we'll live our youth to the—

Partway through, I had a feeling that might happen.
She was having genuine fun with BNW, getting fiercely passionate about it.
choice_data_list: Watching you all reminds me of my youth.
Watching you all reminds me of my youth.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: "Really...? Well then, all's well that ends well, I suppose?"
choice_data_list: Yeah. I think it's fine to stay like this!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
For you to emphasize it that much, Trainer.
Fufu, you truly mean it, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"The media coverage that used to be all about BNW
has finally started including me as well."

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I'm being treated
on equal footing with Hayahide-san and the others now!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"Let's take this relationship even further
and step onto the next stage in the Senior Year!"
choice_data_list: Then how about making the Osaka Hai our next goal?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
A classic Senior Year spring medium-distance race.
Umamusume from older generations will probably run too, so it should leave a fresh impression!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: We haven't scouted the older generation much yet, but let's develop a plan step by step!
